description:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26002002
DOCKET NO. F00384525
PLAINTIFF: NEWREZ LLC D/B/A SHELLPOINT MORTGAGE SERVICING
DEFENDANT(S): RICHARD JAMES FRANOLICH
ATTORNEY:
PINCUS & TARAB, ATTORNEYS AT LAW, PLLC
525 Route 73 North, Suite 309
MARLTON, NJ 08053
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered, I have levied upon and will expose for sale at public vendue on 13th DAY of November 2026 between the hours of twelve and four o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say, at 12:00 P.M. prevailing time at the Large Conference Room, 2 Bergen County Plaza, Hackensack, New Jersey to wit:
All that certain lot, piece or parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon erected, situate, lying and being in OAKLAND, County of Bergen and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 1, BLOCK 4506
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
70 LAKESHORE DRIVE OAKLAND, NJ 07436
The short form description provided herein does not constitute a full legal description. A full legal description is annexed to the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Bergen County.
Lien(s)/Taxes/CWPP: GOOD FAITH ESTIMATED UPSET: $467,895.47. PLEASE BE ADVISED THAT DEFINITIVE OCCUPANCY INFORMATION IS NOT AVAILABLE AND PLAINTIFF MAKES NO REPRESENTATION REGARDING OCCUPANCY. DIMENSIONS: 109.46FT X 125.0FT X 146.61FT X 130.40FT. NEAREST CROSS STREET: ROCKAWAY AVENUE. ALL INTERESTED PARTIES ARE TO CONDUCT AND RELY UPON THEIR OWN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATION TO ASCERTAIN WHETHER OR NOT ANY OUTSTANDING INTEREST REMAIN OF RECORD AND/OR HAVE PRIORITY OVER THE LIEN BEING FORECLOSED AND, IF SO THE CURRENT AMOUNT DUE THEREON. **IF THE SALE IS SET ASIDE FOR ANY REASON, THE PURCHASER AT THE SALE SHALL BE ENTITLED ONLY TO A RETURN OF THE DEPOSIT PAID. THE PURCHASER SHALL HAVE NO FURTHER RECOURSE AGAINST THE MORTGAGOR, THE MORTGAGEE OR THE MORTGAGEE'S ATTORNEY.
Together with all and singular the rights, liberties, privileges, hereditaments and appurtenances thereunto belonging or in anywise appertaining and the reversion and remainders, rents, issues and profits thereof, and also all the estate, right, title, interest, use, property, claim and demand of the said defendants of, in, to and out of the same, be sold to pay and satisfy in the first place unto the said plaintiff plus interest thereon. The property shall be sold subject to all liens and encumbrances of record and the Sheriff makes no representations, express or implied, as to the existence, amount, or validity of any liens and encumbrances on the property which is the subject matter of this sale. This notice is further subject to the Conditions of Sale as set forth by the Sheriff of Bergen County and is subject to the terms and conditions of the Foreclosure Fairness Act. The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice through publication.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $427,823.20 plus interest, costs and fees of the sale, and the Sheriff's fees and commission. Any prior liens, as per the affidavit of consideration, are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff. The approximate upset price listed below is not accurate. The correct upset price is listed in this sale notice.
ANTHONY CURETON, SHERIFF
DATED: October 13, 2026
